title: Ship-To Tenure and the Review Spend Basis
content:
**Service level review standard — Ship-To Fulfillment Account: length of time open.**

The review spend follows how long the ship-to has been open on the review date, counted in whole months from its opened date (0 months where the ship-to has no opened date), and is set from the counted twelve-month figure and twice the counted six-month figure: for a ship-to open at least 60 months the review spend is the lower of the two; for a ship-to open fewer than 24 months it is the higher of the two.

The counted twelve-month figure and the counted six-month figure are the twelve-month spend and the six-month spend of the review as counted for the review. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.

### Condition, judgement, result

| Whole months open on the review date | Review spend under this rule |
|---|---|
| fewer than 24 (including 0 months for a ship-to with no opened date) | the higher of the counted twelve-month figure and twice the counted six-month figure |
| 24 to 59 | not set from the two figures under this rule |
| 60 or more | the lower of the counted twelve-month figure and twice the counted six-month figure |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Open 23 whole months: the higher of the two. Open 24: neither treatment.
- Open 59 whole months: neither treatment. Open 60: the lower of the two.
- A ship-to opened on the 15th of a month and reviewed on the 14th of the month exactly 60 calendar months later has been open 59 whole months; reviewed on the 15th it has been open 60.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

Counted twelve-month figure 30000.00; counted six-month figure 12000.00, so twice the six-month figure is 24000.00.

- Ship-to open 70 whole months: review spend 24000.00, the lower of the two.
- Ship-to open 10 whole months: review spend 30000.00, the higher of the two.
